<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: center">Statement of Domestication</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">(a)&nbsp;The name of the domesticating
entity is Superior Silver Mines, Inc., the type of entity being a corporation incorporated under the laws of the State of Idaho;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">(b)&nbsp;The name of the domesticated
entity is Superior Silver Mines, Inc., with its original jurisdiction of organization the State of Idaho; the entity is being re-domesticated
in the state of Nevada.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">(c)&nbsp;The Statement of Domestication
shall become effective upon the filing with the Idaho Secretary of State.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify">(d)&nbsp;The Plan of Domestication was
approved in accordance with the provisions of Part&nbsp;5 of the Idaho Entity Transactions Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 17.8pt 0 18pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>
